name: Atopia
summary:
**Atopia** is the metaverse for arts and culture: a high-quality Web & VR platform that brings exhibitions from museums across the world, such as The Metropolitan Museum of Art, right into your home.

Wander through architected virtual spaces, view artworks and artifacts in detail, and experience stories that unfold around you. Join friends to explore together, or browse solo at your own pace. New cultural spaces are added on a rolling basis!
